soalan.s: The purpose of Danial's message is to
soalan.h: Text purpose: declining and suggesting another time.

a.x: Every Friday, the car park near Aina's flat turns into a busy night market. By six o'clock, traders have set up their stalls under bright lamps. Aina's favourite stall belongs to Mr Lim, who sells crispy apam balik. He has been making them for twenty years and still smiles at every customer. Last week, it rained heavily and most traders packed up early, but Mr Lim stayed until nine because he did not want his regular customers to go home disappointed. Aina thinks that the night market is not just a place to buy food; it is where the neighbours meet and catch up on news.

b.t: Passage B: A Message from Danial
b.x: Hi Kai, thanks for inviting me to your birthday party on Saturday. I'm sorry, but I can't come because my family is visiting my grandmother in Ipoh. She has been unwell, so we want to spend the weekend with her. Could we celebrate together on Monday after school instead? I'll bring the board game you wanted to try. Have a great party! Danial

c.x:
The river hums a quiet song,
it carries leaves and sticks along.
It never stops, it never sleeps,
its secrets in the stones it keeps.
When rain is heavy, loud it roars;
when sun is hot, it calmly snores.
